items.title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
items.summary: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.

items.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
items.summary: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
items.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.

items.title: Why 42 Macro says it’s waiting to buy the Bitcoin dip
items.summary: The independent macro research company warns the Bitcoin sell-off may not have yet run its course.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
items.summary: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.

items.title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks
items.summary: Strategy raised its preferred stock buyback limit to $4 billion and authorized the transfer of up to $1 billion from its dollar reserve.

items.title: BTC price gains 12% from $55K: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.summary: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 3.1% before Monday’s open, while Wednesday’s US inflation report could shape expectations for a December rate hike.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.8B in third-largest weekly outflow
items.summary: Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $4.14 billion in November through Friday, nearing June’s $4.51 billion total.

items.title: Will Bitcoin’s big rebound hold? More tampered Ledgers found: Hodler’s Digest
items.summary: Bitcoin rebounds sharply from its new cycle low, but is $55,111 really the bottom? Ledger investigates new reports of tampered devices in Berlin and the UAE.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
items.summary: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
items.summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

items.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
items.summary: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.
